ops.body: Audited 2026-07-14 against the installed Xcode 26 SDK (build 26.5) + web. VERDICT: no API exists to place an FP domain root outside ~/Library/CloudStorage. Method: availability-macro diff of every FileProvider.framework header — the ONLY macOS-26-gated additions are FILEPROVIDER_API_AVAILABILITY_SEARCH (NSFileProviderSearching/supportsStringSearchRequest, NSFileProviderDomain.h:279) and FILEPROVIDER_API_AVAILABILITY_SYNC_CONTROLS (modify-item conflict options + NSFileProviderUserInfoExperimentIDKey) — neither touches placement. initWithDisplayName:userInfo:volumeURL: is macOS 15-era and scoped to external/removable volumes via NSFileProviderExternalVolumeHandling, not arbitrary boot-volume paths; "CloudStorage" appears nowhere in the headers (system detail, not settable). NSFileProviderTesting.h unchanged since 11.3. Web corroborates (Apple dev-forums "Impossibility to change File Provider path"; the macOS 26.4 "volume controls" note is an MDM allow/deny-list feature, support.apple.com/en-us/124963, not placement API). The account-dir symlink indirection stays; pool.ClassifyAccountDir remains the single swap seam if this ever changes. Criterion met.
